t_user.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `t_user` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '用户ID',
  `username` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '用户名',
  `password` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '密码(加密存储)',
  `nickname` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '昵称(显示用)',
  `email` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '邮箱',
  `avatar` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '头像URL',
  `created` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_username` (`username`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=COUNTER DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT='用户表'

t_category.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `t_category` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '分类ID',
  `name` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',
  `slug` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '分类缩略名(用于URL)',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_slug` (`slug`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=COUNTER DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT='分类表'

t_post.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `t_post` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '文章ID',
  `title` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '文章标题',
  `slug` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '文章缩略名(用于URL)',
  `content` longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT '文章内容(Markdown)',
  `content_html` longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT '文章内容(HTML)',
  `summary` varchar(500) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '文章摘要',
  `thumbnail` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '封面图URL',
  `category_id` bigint DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '分类ID',
  `status` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT 'PUBLISHED' COMMENT '状态: DRAFT/PUBLISHED',
  `type` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT 'POST' COMMENT '类型: POST/PAGE',
  `created` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
  `modified` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '更新时间',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_slug` (`slug`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=COUNTER DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT='文章表'

t_tag.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `t_tag` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '标签名称',
  `slug` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '标签缩略名',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_name` (`name`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_slug` (`slug`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=COUNTER DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT='标签表'

t_post_tag.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `t_post_tag` (
  `post_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '文章ID',
  `tag_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '标签ID',
  PRIMARY KEY (`post_id`,`tag_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT='文章-标签关联表'

t_comment.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `t_comment` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '评论ID',
  `post_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '关联文章ID',
  `parent_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '父评论ID',
  `author` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '评论者昵称',
  `email` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '评论者邮箱',
  `url` varchar(200) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '评论者网址',
  `ip` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '评论者IP',
  `user_agent` varchar(500) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '评论者浏览器信息',
  `content` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '评论内容',
  `status` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT 'APPROVED' COMMENT '状态: APPROVED/WAITING/SPAM',
  `is_admin` tinyint(1) DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '是否博主评论',
  `created` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '评论时间',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_post_id` (`post_id`),
  KEY `idx_parent_id` (`parent_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=COUNTER DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT='评论表'

t_option.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `t_option` (
  `option_key` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '配置键',
  `option_value` longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT '配置值',
  PRIMARY KEY (`option_key`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT='系统配置表'

t_link.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `t_link` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '友链ID',
  `name` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '网站名称',
  `url` varchar(1024) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '网站地址',
  `logo` varchar(1024) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '网站Logo/头像',
  `description` varchar(1024) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '网站描述',
  `team` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT 'Friends' COMMENT '分组',
  `sort` int DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '排序',
  `created` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=COUNTER DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT='友情链接表'
